title: Grace
creator: CrossFit
description: Thirty clean and jerks at 135/95 lb for time. Programmed since 2004, Grace is a sprint with a moderately heavy barbell; power clean and push jerk is the intended style, and the best athletes finish in under two minutes. Scale the load so you can keep moving in small sets.
